summary.headline: Astrological Lots and Fixed Stars
summary.text: Codex folio catalogue describing astrological material on royal lots, trigonal lords, planetary rays and aspects, the Ascending and Descending Nodes, annual solstices, tetrarchs, and the four lots, with cross-references to Vienna and Florence codices. Later folios preserve Ptolemy’s phases of the fixed stars, weather signs, and a demonstration of the fixed stars, with astronomical figures added by a scribe.
